newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds firmer on Ecofin euro pledges.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds firmer on Ecofin euro pledges.

text.p: Portuguese bonds were firm in early trade, buoyed by statements at the Ecofin meeting that the European single currency would start on time, dealers said.
"Futures are rising a little with the rest of Europe after pledges at Ecofin that the euro will start in 1999," said a fixed income analyst.
A dealer said: "Present spread levels of 70 to 80 bps (against Bunds) reflect caution pending more news about Ecofin."
Another fixed income analyst said: "If the escudo remains under selling pressure against the mark, shorter bonds will not have much room to gain."
